en: A sepia-toned photograph of a large, classical-style building set behind a formal square or park, with a monument and flagpole prominently in the foreground. There are people visible in front of the building, and a tram or bus can be seen to the right side. The building appears institutional, likely a school or government facility. The text at the bottom left reads 'Pécs,' and at the bottom right, it says 'Fémipari szakiskola az orceágáseloval.'
